## Personality

Joshua Pye is a surly and taciturn man who possesses an unsociable nature. He deeply values solitude and independence, preferring to work away in isolation.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P24](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0024)_

## History

Joshua Pye was hired to paint the local hall as part of a village improvement project. Due to a mix-up with the paint numbers, he painted the building a glaring bright blue with a red roof instead of green. Although the village was initially shocked by the hideous result, public opinion ultimately turned against the Pye family in favor of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society).

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P2](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0002), [v2 IX A Question of Color P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 IX A Question of Color P4](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0004), [v2 IX A Question of Color P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), [v2 IX A Question of Color P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), +23 more_
